skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 60% ATK as DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 130% ATK as DMG to the target's column and grants them [Unyielding].

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 130% > 150% ATK as DMG to the target's column, grants them [Unyielding], and additionally grants [Unyielding] to all allies.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: +20% HP. On entry, gains +60% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. After any unit acts, heals self for 10% of max HP.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: [Non-Crit DMG Free] 60% > 70%. Heal after any unit acts 10% > 15% of max HP.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: [Non-Crit DMG Free] 70% > 80%. Heal after any unit acts 15% > 20% of max HP.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: Marks the main target, reducing its Max HP by 600% of Atomic Samurai's ATK (up to 50% of the target's Max HP), and negates any Max HP increase effects on the target. After action, if Atomic Samurai defeats the marked target or triggers [Unyielding] / [Enhanced Unyielding] on it, activates [Chase] (Ultimate Follow-up) on a random enemy, dealing 80% of the Ultimate DMG.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Additional effect: permanently decreases the marked enemy's ATK by 40%. Ultimate Follow-up ATK 80% > 120% (now triggers after any action).

effects.desc: Shield ignores damage from certain attacks. Must be penetrated by Breakthrough or Charge/True DMG.
